articles.summary: For Antonio “Iggy” Ignacio, checking in on a friend is a simple act. But he knows firsthand that sometimes, the timing can be everything. A production supervisor at Lithionics and a 1999 graduate of the U.S. Military Academy at West Point, Ignacio has long made a habit of reaching out to classmates simply to see how they are doing.
articles.title: “Hey, just checking in”: Iggy Ignacio and the Bravo Charlie Initiative
